verdict.rationale: Automatic type inference is a fair axis for a UI framework, but the pack has no first-party documentation of inferring prop or emitted-event types. Community reports point the other way: users say prop types still had to be specified manually [vue-comm-3] and call TypeScript support mediocre [vue-comm-15, vue-comm-17]. With no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.
